Normally Courts do not refer cases where allegations are under Section 376 IPC to mediation and the Courts ought not to do so, but in this case, the Complainant has filed a case under the Domestic Violence Act against the Petitioner stating that she is the wife of the Petitioner and has claimed maintenance on the ground that they were in a domestic relationship through a relationship in the nature of marriage.
This gives the colour of a matrimonial dispute to the case.

The Petitioner has filed this application for referring the present case to mediation.
The offences for which the FIR has been filed are under Sections 376, 377, 506 IPC.
2.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Normally Courts do not refer cases where allegations are under Section 376 IPC to mediation and the Courts ought not to do so, but in this case, the Complainant has filed a case under the Domestic Violence Act against the Petitioner stating that she is the wife of the Petitioner and has claimed maintenance on the ground that they were in a domestic relationship through a relationship in the nature of marriage.
This gives the colour of a matrimonial dispute to the case.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the above, this Court is inclined to refer the dispute to Delhi High Court Mediation &
Conciliation Centre.
It is made clear that if the Mediator after looking into the case is of the opinion that it is not a domestic relationship, then the Mediator can refuse to entertain to mediate the dispute between the parties and send the matter back to the Court.
Let the parties appear before the Delhi High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre on 18.07.2024 at 3:00 PM.
5. The parties are directed to produce the case records of CRL.M.C.739/2024, which are the proceedings under the Domestic Violence Act before the learned Mediator for the purpose of ascertaining the true nature of the dispute.
6. The application is disposed of.
List on 22.08.2024, to await the Mediation Report as to whether this is a fit case for mediation or not.
